note: Both sets are largely faithful to the wiring schedule, but Set A binds every value cleanly to the correct row and property, including 150's #4G ground conductor, 20's 3#12 conductors, and 50's 3#6 conductors, which Set B omits. Set B's main flaw is the 150 claim 'conductor configuration | 3#4/0, #4G.', which folds the ground conductor into the conductor configuration, and its 'Wiring 10 | conductor size | #12/2WG' treats a cable designation as a conductor size. Set A also covers 32's USE-2 wire type and 34's 3#10G ground explicitly, giving it slightly better coverage with no misbindings.
